lessons.title: The Hopper sensor suite
lessons.summary: Learn what can actually be seen on the classroom aircraft, what the flight controller must estimate, and how to describe sensors without turning inference into fact.

lessons.title: How an X-quadrotor flies
lessons.summary: Build an accurate mental model of thrust, torque, coordinate frames, and the X-configuration using the supplied paper’s NED/FRD convention.

lessons.title: Coding blocks field guide
lessons.summary: A complete, student-facing map of every Hopper block category, including defaults, units, fresh-scan behavior, and safety consequences.

lessons.title: JavaScript API reference
lessons.summary: Every supported student-facing JavaScript command, with argument units, defaults, return values, scan freshness, and flight-safety behavior.

lessons.title: Binary vision and thresholding
lessons.summary: Understand the exact brightness equation, calibrate a threshold from evidence, and build decisions that survive shadows, glare, and noise.

lessons.title: Object detection and Hopper’s default neural network
lessons.summary: Name the exact detector, trace its real tensor shapes, understand what its 4.5 million coefficients do, and use confidence without pretending it is certainty.

lessons.title: Teachable Machine image models
lessons.summary: Design classes, collect balanced evidence, export the correct three files, and understand why a whole-frame classifier is not an object detector.

lessons.title: AprilTags with Hopper
lessons.summary: Understand the tag36h11 family, the local detection pipeline, normalized pose fields, and the exact limits of Hopper’s centering controller.

lessons.title: Python coding reference
lessons.summary: Every supported Python command and helper, with explicit defaults, named arguments, return shapes, language differences, and safe mission patterns.
